info.name: Employee Leave Management System - API Tests
info.description:
Complete Postman test suite for all APIs (auth, employees, departments, leave types, balances, leaves, admin, dashboards).

HOW TO RUN
1. Start the backend (http://localhost:8080) with the seeded admin (admin@gmail.com / Admin@123) and default settings (app.leave.exclude-weekends=true).
2. Import this collection (and the environment file), select the environment.
3. Run the WHOLE collection in order with the Collection Runner (right-click collection > Run). The first request creates a new runId, so every run uses fresh users and can be repeated.
4. All requests contain assertions (pm.test). Folders must run in order because later folders reuse tokens and ids stored in collection variables.
